criteria.criterion: The run's spend is summed in memory from the sessions as they finish; nothing on disk is re-read to decide the cost ceiling, so a work session that zeroes earlier cost_usd values still hits a ceiling set just above the real spend (exit 6).
criteria.evidence: iterate.go: it.spent is read once at the start of the run, then incremented with wres.Cost and rres.Cost; the ceiling check uses it.spent. TestRunCostRecordsZeroed asserts exit 6.

criteria.criterion: Model and effort per session kind are resolved once at the start of the run; a work session that sets model.review = "haiku" in .vloop/config.toml does not change the model the next review runs with.
criteria.evidence: resolve.go ResolveRun/Resolved.For, called once in Run(); iterate() uses it.resolved.For. TestRunSessionInputsRestored asserts the review argv has --model sonnet.

criteria.criterion: Before each work and review session the driver hashes .vloop/config.toml, .vloop/defects/, .vloop/interventions/ and the run's own session and report records; a change is restored, run.log gets `vloop: <phase> session changed <path> — restored` with a repo-relative path, and a review session's verdict is forced to FAIL.
criteria.evidence: safety.go snapshotInputs/restore (bytes held in memory, repo-relative paths); iterate.go restoreInputs logs the message and inputsChanged forces OutRejected/FAIL after review. TestRunReviewInputsFail asserts T1:rejected then T1:done.

criteria.criterion: Every work and review session runs with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 set to the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the state.json bytes the driver holds.
criteria.evidence: iterate.go passes PlanSHA: planHash(guard.pre) for both phases; session.go sets the env var. planHash returns hex.EncodeToString, which is lower-case.

criteria.criterion: vloop task gate, when VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 is set and differs from the plan file's hash, exits 1 with exactly `vloop: the plan was changed during this session — gates run only from the plan the driver holds` and runs nothing; without the variable, or with a matching hash, it behaves as before. The driver records such a refusal in run.log when it finds it.
criteria.evidence: task_gate.go checkPlanHash runs before the verify. TestTaskGatePlanHash checks the exact stderr, exit 1, and the marker file absent. The gate-refused note is logged by restoreInputs.

criteria.criterion: internal/cli/task_gate_test.go holds TestTaskGatePlanHash (a mismatched hash: exit 1, the verify, which would create a marker file, not run); cmd/vloop/run_inputs_test.go holds TestRunCostRecordsZeroed, TestRunSessionInputsRestored and TestRunReviewInputsFail (a review session that changes .vloop/config.toml is failed); each fails against the base.
criteria.evidence: All four tests exist with real assertions. Existing tests in task_gate_test.go were only appended to. The base lacks the behaviour each asserts.

criteria.criterion: Detection compares hashes of the files before and after the session, not the commands it ran (brief: Violations).
criteria.evidence: inputGuard compares file bytes before and after the session (byte-equal, which is stronger than a hash); it never inspects the session's commands.
